title: Pine Shore Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Spend your next vacation tucked away in Seagrove's NatureWalk overlooking the Nature Preserve. 'Pine Shore' is a four bedroom, three and half bathroom abode that boasts fabulous accommodations for up to ten guests.
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - NEW 6-Seater Golf Cart available for the 2025 rental season! - 4 Bikes for guests to enjoy! - Open floor plan allowing lots of natural light - 2 living spaces on the main level, both with large flat screen TVs and ample seating - Working gas fireplace on main level- perfect for the winter visitors! - 2 KING suites plus an additional queen suite and bunk room - 2 Covered screened porches and 2 open air outdoor balconies - Backyard featuring a gas fire pit with 6 Adirondack chairs - Gas grill, outdoor dining table - Outdoor Shower - Wireless Internet and 5 tv’s with cable and streaming capabilities - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: **Optional Cancellation Protection**- Allows cancellation for ANY reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies paid returned ($150 fee applies at booking). -Use of owner's golf cart with signed liability waiver and $1500 refundable security desposit Welcome to Pine Shore — a stunning 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath retreat in the sought-after NatureWalk at Seagrove, nestled beside Point Washington State Forest and just off scenic 30A. Perfect for families, this spacious beach home sleeps 10 and features an open floor plan, two living areas with flat-screen TVs, and a cozy gas fireplace for cooler nights. Start your mornings on the screened porch, sipping coffee to the sounds of nature — no bugs, just peace. One of the few homes in NatureWalk with a backyard, Pine Shore offers a private outdoor oasis: fire pit with Adirondack chairs, gas grill, dining area, rinse-off shower, and direct views of the nature preserve. Steps away, The Gathering Place awaits with resort-style pools (including a heated lap pool), hot tub, fire pit, playground, fitness stations, and courts for pickleball, basketball, and volleyball. Enjoy scenic trails scented with pine and magnolia, or bike the short path to the sugar-white beaches and crystal-clear Gulf waters. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: Floor 2 Bedroom 1- King suite with private bath, separate tub and shower, large closet (can hold full size crib), TV, direct access to private outdoor balcony Bedroom 2- King suite, TV with private bath- tub/shower combo Bedroom 3- Queen bedroom, TV Shared hall bath, tub shower combo Bedroom 4- Bunk room sleeping 4 in twin beds **This house comes with use of a 6-seater golf cart. A $1500 refundable damage deposit and waiver must be signed pre-arrival to use. You must be 25 yrs or older to drive the golf cart. ** No pets allowed ** All rentals must be 7 nights per the HOA community guidelines. We will not be able to accept any reservations for less than 7 nights. ** Based on the daily temperature and the HOA’s discretion, the lap pool is seasonally heated. * No boats, pull behind trailers or street parking permitted in the community. * There must be one adult at least 25 years of age staying at the property to rent. * If bringing an electric vehicle, please alert management in advance. There will be a $150 charge. FREE WIFI

Amenities: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF

all: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
